# crosswork_te_link_affinity (Resource)

This resource can manage one link affinity for traffic engineering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_te_link_affinity" "example" {
  name         = "cwtest-link"
  bit_position = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bit_position` (Number) Bit position of the affinity
  - Range: `0`-`31`
- `name` (String) Name of the affinity

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_te_link_affinity.example "<id>"
```
